area: Switchback path rays and the black-hole glow
summary: SwitchbackPathRays.SharedMaterial and BlackHoleGlow.SharedMaterial now call WorldColorTrace.Paint on the material they Resources.Load, so the I4 gauntlet's path rays and the mobile black-hole glow wear the worn colour set from their first frame (they were loaded after the scene's repaint and kept Photic's colours for the whole match). One line each; nothing else in either file changed.
why: Colour trace review: a traced Resources material loaded after the repaint was never painted; colour_trace.py --check now fails on any loader that does not paint.
